category_title: Struggling readers who use physical activity and gestures to participate
scenario_title: Encoding words during Title I intervention
minimal_context: Luis is at the board during a Title I intervention session, attempting to write and change words.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Who can write vet on the board?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Taps and writes a v) I think the next letter is a.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just put down what you think.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you change vet to pet?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Motions with his hands) The things that I forget in reading is the words,

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Who can write vet on the board?

STUDENT: (Taps and writes a v) I think the next letter is a.

TUTOR: Just put down what you think.

STUDENT: (Adds e-t to the board)

TUTOR: Can you change vet to pet?

STUDENT: (Motions with his hands) The things that I forget in reading is the words,

task.content: Writing the word 'vet' on the board using letter-sound correspondence and changing 'vet' to 'pet'

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When asked 'Who can write vet on the board?' and 'Can you change vet to pet, Luis?'
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: writes a v, says 'I think the next letter is a.', and writes p-i
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Expressing frustration about his difficulty with word recall during reading.
related_quotes: I think the next letter is a.
The things that I forget in reading is the words,

behavior_patterns.condition: During phonics lessons involving choral reading or chanting.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: participates by motioning, tapping, and “reading” slightly behind the voices of his peers.
